subject: English
passage: In 1943, Sybilla Masters developed a new method for cleaning and curing corn that was implemented in mills across colonial America. Two years later, Masters ______ her technique to create the first automated grain processing system in the New World.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of verb forms within a sentence. A main clause requires a finite (tensed) verb to perform the action of the subject (in this case, Masters), and this choice supplies the finite past tense verb "adapted" to indicate what Masters did with the technique she had developed.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because it results in an ungrammatical sentence. The nonfinite to-infinitive "to adapt" doesn't supply the main clause with a finite verb.
